title: Impastable Marinara Pasta
description: Impastable pasta tossed with a little smooth marinara, with extra sauce on the side, to serve beside Chicken Parmesan.

steps.title: Boil water
steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously with {salt}.

steps.title: Cook pasta
steps.text: Cook {pasta} according to the package directions. Drain.

steps.title: Warm sauce
steps.text: While the pasta cooks, warm {marinara} in a saucepan.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the pasta with just enough sauce to coat it lightly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the remaining sauce on the side.

notes: Serve it next to the chicken, not under it, so the breading stays crisp.
